title: The Understudy WIP
description: Work-in-progress build of The Understudy, a new playable character for Slay the Spire 2. Shared for friend testing. Requires BaseLib.
changeNote: v1.13.51: Fixed Tuned cards (e.g. One-Up) previewing double their damage/Block in the draw-pile and deck views (it showed 2 while hand showed 1). The Tuned preview bonus is now applied idempotently, so a second preview pass can't double it. Removes the v1.13.50 diagnostic logging.
